visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a grey Hello Kitty oversized t-shirt and beige shorts, is in a minimalist bedroom. She clutches her stomach, grimacing with hunger. Yellow text at the top reads 'POV: 當你在家肚子餓...'. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit bathroom where the woman brushes her teeth, looking exhausted and weary. (3) She enters a modern kitchen with white marble countertops and opens a large stainless steel refrigerator. She grabs a vacuum-sealed pack of raw chicken and attempts to bite into it. A man wearing a black t-shirt enters the frame, looking shocked and holding a white Vermicular electric pot. (4) Close-up shots display raw ingredients: two marinated chicken breasts on a ceramic plate, a platter of white and brown mushrooms, and a small bowl of minced garlic. (5) The man operates the digital touch interface of the white electric pot. He adds oil and minced garlic, followed by the chicken breasts. The pot sits on a white kitchen counter under bright, even lighting. (6) He uses wooden chopsticks to flip the chicken, revealing a golden-brown, seared texture. The chicken is then placed on a bed of mushrooms inside the pot, and a white lid is closed. (7) The finished dish is shown: juicy, sliced roasted chicken served over mushrooms. The woman is seated at a light-colored wooden table, eating the chicken and rice with chopsticks, expressing extreme satisfaction. (8) Finally, she poses with a Vermicular cookbook while several text overlays appear regarding a limited-time sale and link information.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a soft, slow piano melody accompanied by a female voice speaking in a low, tired tone, whining 'I'm so hungry.' (2) A bright, digital bell chime triggers a transition to a high-energy, acoustic pop background track. A male narrator begins speaking with a sharp, professional, and enthusiastic delivery. (3) Distinct sizzling sound effects are heard as meat hits a hot surface, layered over the male narrator describing ingredients. (4) Mechanical clicking and beep sounds are heard as the appliance buttons are pressed. (5) Sounds of food being sliced and the clinking of ceramic are present. The woman's voice returns, now high-pitched and joyful, expressing delight with exclamations like 'Oh!' and 'So good!' as she eats. (6) The video ends with a faster pace of dialogue and upbeat music as the promotion concludes.

It uses a comedic 'POV' hook of a woman being extremely hungry to transition into a step-by-step cooking demonstration showing how the product makes cooking professional-quality meals easy and juicy.
